title: A Deadly Scheme
front_description: On Coruscant, a mysterious bounty hunter named Zam Wesell receives instructions from an equally—mysterious, armor-clad employer. Soon, Wesell is sending an assassin droid containing deadly kouhuns to the skyscraper apartment of Padmé Amidala. The deadly, kouhuns slip past R2-D2, but the alert Jedi sense the danger and Anakin makes quick work of them with his lightsaber.
back_description: Edwin Natividad's concept of the repulsive, worm-like kouhuns.
